'''[[Tehran]]''' is one of the most ethnically diverse cities in [[Asia]]. The city of Tehran (not to be confused with the larger, Tehran Metropolitan) had a population of approximately 9,729,740 in 2025<ref>{{Cite web |title=Tehran Population 2025 |url=https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/iran/tehran |access-date=2025-03-24 |website=worldpopulationreview.com}}</ref> and the Tehran Province had a 14,437,000 population in 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Tehrān (Province, Iran) - Population Statistics, Charts, Map and Location |url=https://www.citypopulation.de/en/iran/prov/admin/23__tehr%C4%81n/ |access-date=2025-03-24 |website=www.citypopulation.de}}</ref>

==Ethnic groups==
===Persians===
According to a 2010 census conducted by the Sociology Department of [[Tehran University]] in many districts of Tehran across various socio-economic classes in proportion to the population sizes of each district and socio-economic class, 63% of people in [[Tehran]] were born in Tehran, 98% can speak the [[Persian language]], 75% identify themselves as ethnic [[Persian people|Persians]], and 13% have some degree of proficiency in a [[European language]].<ref>"Chand Darsad Tehranihaa dar Tehran Bedonyaa Amadand" (How many percent of Tehranis were born in Tehran), accessed December, 2010 [http://www.tabnak.ir/fa/news/133668][https://web.archive.org/web/20101204044652/http://www.aftabnews.ir/vdchimnzw23nzid.tft2.html][http://www.jahannews.com/vdcgw39qzak9tn4.rpra.html]</ref>

===Azerbaijanis===
Azerbaijanis in Tehran also known as Turks in Tehran or Azeris in Tehran are [[Iran]]ians of [[Azerbaijanis|Azerbaijani]] ethnicity. Azerbaijanis comprise 25% of [[Tehran]]'s population and 20.3%<ref>National Bibliography Number: 2887141 / plan review and assess the country's culture indicators (indicators Ghyrsbty) {report}: [[Tehran Province]] / General Council of the Order of the Executive Director is responsible for planning and policy: Mansoor Vaezi; run company experienced researchers Us - {{ISBN|978-600-6627-42-7}} * Publication Status: Tehran - Institute Press book, published in 1391 * appearance: 296 p: table (the color), diagrams (colored part)</ref> – 25%<ref name="Library of Congress Iran">"Chapter 2 - The Society and Its Environment: People and Languages: Turkic-speaking Groups: Azarbaijanis" in ''A Country Study: Iran'' [[Library of Congress Country Studies]], [http://lcweb2.loc.gov/cgi-bin/query/r?frd/cstdy:@field(DOCID+ir0052) Table of Contents], last accessed 19 November 2008</ref> of [[Tehran Province]]'s population.

===Mazanderanis===
Ethnic [[Mazanderani people|Mazanderanis]] are the third-largest, comprising about 8.2% of the total population.<ref>{{cite web|archive-date=2010-12-17|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101217025442/http://looklex.com/e.o/teheran.htm|date=2018-06-19|first=Tore|last=Kjeilen|title=Teheran - LookLex Encyclopaedia|url=http://looklex.com/e.o/teheran.htm|url-status=dead|website=looklex.com}}</ref><ref>فهرست نویسی پیش از انتشار کتابخانه ملی جمهوری اسلامی ایران * شماره کتابشناسی ملّی:۲۸۹۰۶۹۰ *عنوان و نام پدیدآورنده:طرح بررسی و سنجش شاخص‌های فرهنگ عمومی کشور (شاخص‌های غیرثبتی){گزارش}:گزارش‌های پیشرفت طرح‌ها وکلان شهرها/به سفارش شورای فرهنگ عمومی کشور؛ مدیر طرح و مسئول سیاست گذاری:منصور واعظی؛ اجرا:شرکت پژوهشگران خبره پارس</ref>
